# Spec: See the queue channels and received messages

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/watch-the-queues.md)

**Start:** `/messaging/queues`  
**Persona:** A developer checking the message queue wiring  
**Goal:** Confirm which provider and queue each channel uses and whether this host receives from it.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Read the configured channels | The channel table lists the provider and queue. |
| 2 | Look at the received messages | A received message is listed with its time and text. |

Source: `e2e/journeys.ts` (journey `watch-the-queues`). Each expected result is asserted by the step's `run` function.
